Name: Farm Ranching Advance
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[size=4][b]Would you like to be able to plant more seeds in the new farm?
[/b][/size][size=3]With this mod you will turn all the terrain of your farm into diggable which will allow you to create much larger plantations without any problem. [/size]

[b]Configuration: [/b]
[list]
[*][b]"FRA_Green": "true"[/b] = It maintains the grass texture on the ground.
[*][b]"FRA_Green": "false"[/b] = Remove the grass texture from the ground.
[*][b]"FRA_SecretCave": "true"[/b] = Activate the secret cave.
[*][b]"FRA_SecretCave": "false"[/b] = Deactivate the secret cave.
[/list][i][size=2]*In case of deactivating the secret cave, you can delete the folder named "[FTM]Farm Ranching Advance".[/size][/i]
[b]
Important:[/b][size=3] This mod replaces the new farm and it is recommended to apply it in a new game.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Important: Many changes have been made that affect the configuration of the mod, so it is necessary to delete all files from the old version.

Manifest.Name: Farm Ranching Advance
Manifest.Description: Improves the new farm added in version 1.6 by making all the terrain diggable and adds more bluegrass.
